images.title: Reading 0.274 digit by digit
images.purpose: Show a decimal in a place table and that it is read digit by digit after the point.
images.composition: A single place table in the centre with a short reading line underneath; nothing else.
exact_structure: A table with 2 rows and 4 columns: header row Ones, Tenths, Hundredths, Thousandths (4 header cells, left to right).
Second row holds the digits 0, 2, 7, 4 in that order, one per column; the 0 in grey (#6B7280), the 2 in teal (#0072B2), the 7 in amber (#E69F00), the 4 in reddish purple (#CC79A7).
A bold dot (the decimal point) sits on the line between the Ones and Tenths columns, in the digit row.
Under the table, one reading line: zero point two seven four.
rejection: the digits are not 0, 2, 7, 4 in this order
the decimal point is not between Ones and Tenths
the number is read as two hundred seventy four
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: After the point, read each digit on its own.
images.description: A place table with digits 0, 2, 7 and 4 under Ones, Tenths, Hundredths and Thousandths, and the words zero point two seven four.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Read the digits left to right after the point.

image_decisions.why: The table links each digit to its place and the way it is said.
